But at BMR Pool and Patio , we believe in creating complete outdoor living experiences. Beyond the crystal-clear waters of our meticulously designed pools, we specialize in transforming your backyard into a haven of comfort and style. Our expertise extends to outdoor kitchens, custom patios, arbors, casitas, pool houses, and exquisite landscaping that seamlessly blend with the natural beauty of your surroundings. reviews.text:
We had an amazing experience working with BMR. Jason (our project manager) and Tyler (our sales consultant) were both fantastic from start to finish.

They truly take care of everything — even coordinating with subcontractors like the fence company, which made the whole process smooth and stress-free. Every time I called, they were available, helpful, and very flexible with all the changes we requested, both during the quoting phase and even in the middle of the project.

They also provided a great 3D model and took the time to explain every detail clearly so we knew exactly what to expect.

Highly recommend BMR, Jason, and Tyler for anyone looking to build a pool!
reviews.author: Alireza Atabaie

reviews.text: Excellent pool contractor! First and foremost, Jason is awesome. He regularly communicates with you and keeps you up to date (even if some aspects of the work are delayed a day or two). I've worked with BMR twice over the past 3 years. The first time I hired them to install a pool and outdoor kitchen (2022). Most recently I had them add a sunshade, inquire about landscaping, and a few minor tweaks to the backyard. The project was on the more difficult side given the smaller space I have in the backyard. I couldn't be happier with the quality of the work. In addition, Stacey (warranty) is incredibly helpful and has assisted with very minor issues that have taken place due to weather events. Chris Benton also gave some of his time to my project and provided some recommendations to the layout. I highly recommend BMR to anyone looking to transfer their backyard space.
reviews.author: Nathan Gibson

reviews.text: One of the most reliable, trusted and excellent outdoor builders. We got six things constructed through BMR. Outdoor kitchen, arbor, pool with spa, pool house, extension of our backyard living area and fence. Mason Thane was always reachable whether he was in country or not. They went to the max extent of calling our HOA and explaining the project to get their approval.
reviews.author: Hari Sundar Venkata Ramani

reviews.text:
We first learnt about BMR through a couple of our friends in our community. They gave us impressive feedback and we went forward with meeting them for an initial discussion. The initial design phase was fairly quick and they were able to present something very close to what me and my wife wanted. Once we got the initial quote, we got similar quotes from other vendors too, to verify if we going to build the best pool with the best price. BMR was able to explain the technicalities in great detail which we could compare with others. Very soon, we were able to trim down the specs to to fit our budget and were able to get the project underway in a couple of weeks from there.

Around the same time, one of our neighbors also started a pool project with another vendor. The pace at which BMR executed the project was noticeably fast, when we were doing comparisons with our neighbor, with every thing from digging the pool, to laying the plumbing and electrical lines, to laying the concrete, coping and finally the deck, the project went very smoothly with constant updates we received from the project manager over text on a daily basis. Any concerns we raised were almost immediately addressed in no time. They managed to complete the project in a little less than 3 months as promised, including a patio upgrade that they managed to squeeze in.

I would highly recommend BMR for pool and patio projects!
reviews.author: Vasant K Easwaran

reviews.text:
After getting multiple bids from various companies, we ultimately chose BMR for our pool remodel due to their professionalism, vision, and a personal recommendation from a friend.

They did not disappoint!  We highly recommend this company and would use them again in a heartbeat. BMR did a complete remodel for us- new deck, tile, coping, and plaster. Prior to starting the project, they scheduled a call to handoff from Sales to our Project Manager. Multiple people from the team joined the meeting to ensure everyone was on the same page; very professional.

Our project manager, Greg, was our main point of contact throughout the project; he kept us in the loop and ensured the project went off without a hitch.

We couldn’t be happier with the end result. BMR showed up when they said they would and stood behind their work. Posting multiple pics of the end result and the last pic is the ‘before pic.’
reviews.author: Jen B

reviews.text:
We are absolutely thrilled with our new pool, and a huge part of that is thanks to Jose, our project manager. From the moment he took over, the process was smooth and stress-free. His communication, professionalism, and attention to detail were outstanding, and the finished product exceeded our expectations. Jose truly deserves 5 stars!

Our sales experience was a bit bumpier. Tyler, the owner's son, was our salesperson. While he was friendly, he came across as inexperienced and slightly unprofessional at times. A few key items—like tree removal and specific sprinkler details—were initially left out of the contract. When we raised concerns, he asked us to just take his word for it. Although those items were eventually added, the wording in the contract was vague and left open to interpretation, which caused some confusion down the line. We also had some add-ons mid-project that could have been avoided with a more accurate and thorough quote from the beginning.

That said, once the project transitioned to Jose, we felt confident and well taken care of. He kept everything on track, was easy to reach, and delivered a pool we truly love. Overall, we’re really happy with the outcome and especially grateful for Jose’s expert oversight.
reviews.author: Stephanie Myers

reviews.text:
We recently moved to Dallas and needed to find a way for some shade on our pool deck. We had several bids and sketches.  We decided to use BMR Pool and Patio.  We are happy with the final product and can't wait to have friends and family over to enjoy the space now that we have shade!!  We are delighted with the design.
Working with Greg was so important.  He was our project manager and to say he went above and beyond is not enough.
He managed our project as if it were in his own home. He was accessible throughout, and I never felt abandoned. Lance was our designer and so easy to work with.
reviews.author: Mary Tyson

reviews.text: We had an amazing experience with BMR! Whenever other pool builders turned us away due to the challenges of our lot, BMR stepped up and gave us a pool that we absolutely love! Great construction and a very easy process. I highly recommend them!
reviews.author: Larry Henderson

data.summary: Reviews appear overwhelmingly authentic. The high Google/Houzz ratings with detailed, specific customer experiences suggest genuine quality. The lower Yelp rating is a common platform discrepancy and does not outweigh the volume and specificity of positive feedback. No evidence of review manipulation found.
fake_signals: No specific fake signals detected in provided review text
Yelp rating anomaly could indicate platform-specific negativity bias
authentic_signals: Extremely specific details in reviews (project manager names, multiple projects over years, HOA coordination)
Varied writing styles and specific project descriptions
Mix of praise with minor constructive feedback (delays mentioned)
Owner responses are professional and appreciative
High review volume with consistent positive themes across Google and Houzz
complaint_patterns: Potential communication/scheduling delays (mentioned in positive reviews)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant rating discrepancy between Google/Houzz (4.7) and Yelp (3.3). This is a common pattern where Yelp attracts more critical reviews and has different filtering algorithms. The BBB A+ rating indicates good complaint handling.
